summary: Core AI Holdings, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq notification for failure to maintain the minimum $1.00 bid price for 30 consecutive trading days (June 17–July 30, 2026). The deficiency triggers a 180-day cure period under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(c)(3)(A), with no immediate delisting impact. The company can regain compliance if the bid price closes at $1.00 or above for 10 consecutive days. This is a routine regulatory notice, not an active delisting event. Watch for potential reverse stock split or compliance actions within the cure period.
